description: Autologic Industries is an auto parts supplier for Colombia, exporting motorcycle clutch parts, motocarro spares and aluminium castings from India.

hero_sub: Clutch, Brake & Casting Parts for Colombian Roads
hero_alt: Two wheeler clutch assembly from the Autologic range for Colombia
hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Colombia. We export clutch systems, brake shoes, engine parts and aluminium castings to importers, distributors and assemblers.

Motorcycles are a major form of transport in Colombia, used for commuting, deliveries and work, from the high-altitude streets of Bogotá to the hot Caribbean coast. Three-wheeler motocarros also carry passengers and cargo in many towns. Browse our range below. Every part is quality tested in our plant before it is packed for export.

network.title: Why Colombian Buyers Source From Us
paras: We bring more than 25 years of drivetrain manufacturing experience and test every component before dispatch.
Ordering clutch, brake and casting lines from one manufacturer reduces supplier management and keeps quality consistent.
We can work from the OEM part numbers your customers use, which makes it easier to list our parts alongside your existing catalogue.

network.title: Shipping Parts to Colombia
paras: Orders travel by sea in palletised export packing to the Colombian port that suits your business, with complete documents for customs.

Cartons can be labelled with your brand and part numbers, which helps distributors who sell through several regional stores.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Colombian market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to Colombia. Samples can be arranged before your first volume order.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, distributors and assemblers in Colombia planning their first order.
faqs: Do you supply motorcycle and motocarro parts to Colombia?
Yes. Our range covers two wheeler clutch parts, three-wheeler clutch and brake parts, engine components and aluminium castings.
Which port do you ship to?
We ship by sea to the Colombian port you choose and provide full export documentation for your customs broker.
Can you make parts to our drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC lines produce components from drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Yes. Samples let you confirm fit and finish before committing to volume orders.
Do your clutch parts handle hot climates and high altitude?
Our friction materials are rated for up to 300°C continuous endurance and our parts are built to OEM-grade tolerances for demanding daily use.
